0.0: My files tell me that you've reached #bLv. 200#k as Resistance. I've carefully and thoughtfully put together some gifts that will help you out. Would you like to accept the gift box now?

no.0: I'll keep the box here for you until you get to Lv. 250, then. After that, it's getting recycled, so don't wait too long.

yes.0: I've placed a special gift box in your Use tab. Now, excuse me. I have a endless pile of pencils that require sharpening!
